en.html:
Bandit Leader"Whatever you do, you are bound to regret it, aren't you. But do nothing, and regret will still come."
Bandit Leader"And 'I could not decide'... I suspect that regret hurts the most."

首領「決断できなかったっていう後悔は、きっと 一番辛いんじゃないかしら……」

Bandit Leader"Your purpose? To live rightly as YOURSELF."
Bandit Leader"What else would it be?"
